state.user_prompt: Summarize the following tweets about Netflix in 5 sentences. Just tell me what normal people think about Netflix; most of these tweets say the same thing anyway, and the odd ones out don’t really represent anyone. Keep it simple.
state.summary: Most people view Netflix as a perfect companion for relaxing at home, often associating it with lazy days spent in sweatpants while eating snacks. Users frequently express a desire to watch specific shows or movies alone because they lack someone to cuddle with during the experience. While some complain about technical issues like loading errors or bad recommendations, the overwhelming sentiment is one of comfort and entertainment value. A recurring theme involves people jokingly begging for password shares from friends or partners to access their favorite content without paying extra. Ultimately, the general public sees Netflix as an essential tool for escaping daily stress and filling time when there is nothing else to do.
